name: starts a closed client with the arguments; it signs in from the saved sign-in, opens the game’s page, and hands over

result.command: "{tmp}\Riot Games\Riot Client\RiotClientServices.exe" --launch-product=valorant --launch-patchline=live (the Riot Client opened the game's page: Auto-launch is disabled)
result.handOff: Press Play in the Riot Client window to start VALORANT; it is open on the game's page.
